related.title: Bluefors 控制線：低溫衰減器的噪聲折衷
related.titleEn: Bluefors control line: cryogenic attenuation and noise tradeoff
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：逐項標記通過、失敗或資料不足，不以熟悉品牌代替證據。最終交接必須包括：交付無量綱指數、兩溫度佔據與溫度計／模式溫度區分表。 所有通過結論只在本課明列假設內成立。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Mark each item pass, fail or insufficient evidence; a familiar brand is not proof. Final handover must include: Deliver dimensionless exponents, occupations at both temperatures and thermometer/mode-temperature distinctions. Every pass remains conditional on the stated teaching assumptions.
related.difference: 建立『Bluefors 控制線：低溫衰減器的噪聲折衷』可核算的名義與變更模型，區分實際來源背景、合成輸入及驗收證據。成果：交付dB／功率換算、極限測試與熱化節點圖。
related.differenceEn: Build reproducible nominal and changed models for 'Bluefors control line: cryogenic attenuation and noise tradeoff', separating sourced context, synthetic inputs and acceptance evidence. Outcome: Deliver dB/power conversions, limiting-case tests and a thermalization-node diagram.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：玻色模式n̄=1/(exp(hf/kBT)−1)；這是平衡模式佔據，不直接等於兩能階激發概率。 使用教學f=5 GHz，T=20 mK；h=6.62607015×10⁻³⁴、kB=1.380649×10⁻²³ SI。 以手算或試算表計算名義式1/(exp(6.62607015e-34*5e9/(1.380649e-23*0.020))-1)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：先檢查無量綱x=hf/(kBT)，再用低佔據exp(−x)交叉比較近似誤差。

先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：教學經典噪聲溫度代理Tout=Tin/A+Tatt(1−1/A)，A為功率衰減比；量子低溫區必須改用模式佔據。 使用合成Tin=300 K、Tatt=4 K、A=100（20 dB）；不是晶片有效溫度。 以手算或試算表計算名義式300/100+4*(1-1/100)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：檢查A=1回到300 K、A很大趨近4 K；dB需用10log10A而非20log10A。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: A bosonic mode has n̄=1/(exp(hf/kBT)−1); equilibrium mode occupation is not identical to two-level excitation probability. Use Teaching f=5 GHz and T=20 mK; h=6.62607015×10⁻³⁴ and kB=1.380649×10⁻²³ in SI. Evaluate nominal expression 1/(exp(6.62607015e-34*5e9/(1.380649e-23*0.020))-1) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check dimensionless x=hf/(kBT), then compare the low-occupation approximation exp(−x).

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Teaching classical noise-temperature proxy Tout=Tin/A+Tatt(1−1/A), with power attenuation A; the quantum cold limit needs mode occupations. Use Synthetic Tin=300 K, Tatt=4 K and A=100(20 dB); this is not chip effective temperature. Evaluate nominal expression 300/100+4*(1-1/100) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check A=1 returns300 K and large A approaches4 K; power dB uses10log10A, not20log10A.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

practice: 先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：玻色模式n̄=1/(exp(hf/kBT)−1)；這是平衡模式佔據，不直接等於兩能階激發概率。 使用教學f=5 GHz，T=20 mK；h=6.62607015×10⁻³⁴、kB=1.380649×10⁻²³ SI。 以手算或試算表計算名義式1/(exp(6.62607015e-34*5e9/(1.380649e-23*0.020))-1)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：先檢查無量綱x=hf/(kBT)，再用低佔據exp(−x)交叉比較近似誤差。

先從模型逐項推導，標記量綱與近似：本機教學吞吐R=Nshots/(Tcal+Nshots·tshot)，不含網路排隊；一次校準可重用的範圍須由漂移資料支持。 使用合成Tcal=2 s、每shot=0.001 s、Nshots=1000。 以手算或試算表計算名義式1000/(2+1000*0.001)，另開一欄執行獨立核對：分別計算總時間3 s與6 s；檢查N很大時吞吐接近1000 shots/s而非無限。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: A bosonic mode has n̄=1/(exp(hf/kBT)−1); equilibrium mode occupation is not identical to two-level excitation probability. Use Teaching f=5 GHz and T=20 mK; h=6.62607015×10⁻³⁴ and kB=1.380649×10⁻²³ in SI. Evaluate nominal expression 1/(exp(6.62607015e-34*5e9/(1.380649e-23*0.020))-1) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Check dimensionless x=hf/(kBT), then compare the low-occupation approximation exp(−x).

Derive each term, marking dimensions and approximations: Local teaching throughput R=Nshots/(Tcal+Nshots·tshot) excludes network queues; calibration reuse needs drift evidence. Use Synthetic Tcal=2 s, tshot=0.001 s and Nshots=1000. Evaluate nominal expression 1000/(2+1000*0.001) by hand or spreadsheet, then independently check: Calculate total times3 s and6 s; verify large-N throughput approaches1000 shots/s rather than infinity.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
